scope: Validated device-direct implementation; local candidate, with two-board and provider evidence indexed in docs/DEVICE_DIRECT_CLOUD_DELIVERY.md

configuration.format: R1CF, version 2, explicit little endian: enabled@8, qwen_generation@12, siyuan_generation@16, reserved[64]@20, qwen_key[257]@84, siyuan_token[257]@341, reserved@598..599, CRC32@600 over first600
configuration.input: Protected AP /service or USB maintenance. USB: idle with device hotspot open: cloud_config newline -> CLOUD_CONFIG READY -> one JSON line <=1024 bytes -> CLOUD_CONFIG RESULT integer
configuration.secrets: ASCII printable nonspace <=256 bytes, no truncation. Use a general-purpose Qianwen AI Platform API key. Absent/empty strings keep values; explicit clear disables cloud mode. No credential history or old relay-token fallback.
configuration.timeout: 15 seconds without input clears and exits; overflow rejects the whole line. No input echo, secret arguments, file persistence or ordinary diagnostic key output.
configuration.generation: Qwen generation changes only with key content, Siyuan only with token. Clear changes its generation when content changes. No-op or mode-only save does not increment either. UINT32 overflow rejects.
configuration.durability: Single blob; no unchanged write. Free-entry admission197 first blob/162 update, then set/commit/close and fresh handle exact readback. Failure still reloads actual value; original historical namespaces are never erased.
configuration.public_post: Existing protected AP /service route requires qwen_generation and siyuan_generation, accepts optional local_only, qwen_key/siyuan_token and clear_qwen/clear_siyuan. Reject duplicate/unknown/legacy URL or pairing fields. Credential-only writes preserve the current mode. Host/Origin/CSRF/content type and bounded request guards unchanged.
configuration.public_get: Flags, generation counters, actual Wi-Fi status, local/cloud mode and last real task state/error only. Configured means complete saved credentials, never authenticated or delivered. No provider tests on save.
configuration.history: Settings do not create old recording intents. Existing same-generation intent can continue after enabling; credential change requires explicit SD account selection. Old memo_cfg1, records1 and sync_r1 remain rollback/history data, never live authentication.
configuration.provider_migration: Version 1 Beijing configuration is read as local-only, retaining Siyuan and both generations. Its Qwen key is not reused. The next explicit Qwen key save writes version 2 and advances the Qwen generation.

network.tls: Fixed official endpoints, trusted CA bundle, hostname/time checks, redirects/WS reconnect disabled
network.hotspot: WPA2 AP with per-device random 8-character password stored in memo_ap/password. Rotate from device screen; restart AP and renew portal session. Manually visit http://192.168.4.1 in Safari; no captive auto-popup or wildcard DNS. Existing AP+STA/Wi-Fi lifecycle and four browser connection limit retained.
network.ui: Selected A layout/B palette/outline, equal modes, Wi-Fi signal/lock icons, aligned refresh/show buttons retained. Provider credentials are write-only over the protected AP. USB maintenance remains supported.

validation_boundary: Host/SDK shims, browser fixture and builds are not actual phone/RF, memory/stack, physical NVS or paid-provider evidence
